tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's public profile (uid, username, display name) plus pro (paid or gifted Instadram Pro). Uses the Bearer token uid only. Available to free users.

tools.name: list_my_bottles
tools.description: List bottles in the signed-in user's collection. Filters: status (unopened|opened|consumed|excluded|wishlist|active|tried) and optional text query. Always scoped to the token uid — a userId argument is ignored.

tools.name: get_my_bottle
tools.description: Get one bottle from the signed-in user's collection by id. 404 if missing or not theirs.

tools.name: get_shelf_value
tools.description: Value of the signed-in user's active shelf (opened + unopened) in USD, the same number as the app's Stats. paid: purchase price, or MSRP when no price was entered (msrpCount says how many used MSRP). msrp: every bottle at MSRP. excludedCount bottles have no usable price. totalCents is exact; total i

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the public bottle catalog (expressions and distilleries). Does not return other users' collections.

tools.name: get_expression
tools.description: Get one public catalog expression by id, or by path distilleries/{id}/brands/{id}/expressions/{id}.

tools.name: list_my_activity
tools.description: List the signed-in user's own pours/activity. Never returns other users' activity.

tools.name: list_my_collections
tools.description: List the signed-in user's shelf groups / collections.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Search public Instadram profiles by exact username (usernames/{handle} or users.username) then displayName prefix. Returns uid, username, displayName, photoURL. Never email or billing fields.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get one public profile by username or userId. Resolves handles via usernames/{handle}. Public fields only — no email, stripeCustomerId, or billing.

tools.name: list_user_bottles
tools.description: List bottles on another user's public shelf. Requires username or userId. Same status/query/paging as list_my_bottles. 404 if the user is missing; empty list if they have no bottles.

tools.name: get_user_bottle
tools.description: Get one bottle from another user's public collection. Requires username or userId plus bottleId. 404 if the user or bottle is missing.

tools.name: list_user_activity
tools.description: List another user's pours/activity (authenticated feed read). Requires username or userId. Newest first. Same paging caps as list_my_activity.

tools.name: list_user_collections
tools.description: List another user's public shelf groups. Requires username or userId.

tools.name: fetch_bottle_reviews
tools.description: AI community-review research for a bottle (fetchBottleReviews). Not a user tasting-note form. iOS may have this flagged off; the tool still works. Pass bottleName, or bottleId (own collection), or username/userId + bottleId to resolve the display name then research. Returns reviews_found, msrp, gene

tools.name: lookup_bottle
tools.description: Add-bottle AI identify (analyzeBourbonImage). Photo (imageData) or text (query). Returns distillery, location, spirit.brand + expressions (name, proof, msrp, tasting_notes, etc.), success, confidence. Does not write a bottle or set expressionRef. Never generates art (transformImage is not used).

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: The Home feed as the app shows it: recent pours, adds and ratings from everyone (scope global, the app default) or only people you follow plus you (scope following). Blocked and hidden accounts are removed.

tools.name: explore_catalog
tools.description: The Explore tab's bottle deck: recent public shelf bottles with photos from other collectors, one per expression, blocked and hidden accounts removed.

tools.name: discover_users
tools.description: Discover people like the app's People list: everyone (empty query) or a name/handle match, ranked like the app, with badge and whether you follow them. Use follow_user to follow.

tools.name: search_cocktails
tools.description: Cocktails to make with a bottle, like the app's recipe rail on a bottle page. Pass the bottle's name (plus spiritType, category, proof when known). Results note how many of the main liquors you already own. For browsing all drinks use explore_recipes.

tools.name: explore_recipes
tools.description: The Explore recipe feed: every drink, ordered by how few bottles you'd need to buy from your own shelf, then popularity. Paged with nextCursor.

tools.name: check_username
tools.description: Check whether an @handle is valid and free before set_username (same rules and messages as Edit Profile).

tools.name: export_shelf
tools.description: Export your whole collection as CSV (Pro, like Profile → Export Collection): the same columns and values as the app's file. Returns filename and csv text.

tools.name: add_bottle_from_photo
tools.description: Add a bottle from a photo, like Add Bottle → photo in the app: the preview identifies it; after the user agrees, AI art is made from the photo (1K) and the bottle is added with it. Free: 5 AI art a day; Pro: unlimited. Two steps: repeat with confirm_token after the user agrees.

tools.name: regenerate_art
tools.description: Make new AI art for one of your bottles from its stored photo (or a new photo), like Think harder → Only regenerate the art. Uses 1 AI art credit (free 5/day, Pro unlimited). Two steps.

tools.name: reidentify_bottle
tools.description: Think harder about one of your bottles: identify it again from its photo and research fresh reviews. Reviews are saved when found; pass update_identity to also replace the name, distillery and proof. Two steps.

tools.name: search_public_bottles
tools.description: Search bottles like the app's Search tab: other collectors' shelf bottles (with owner username and display name) plus public catalog bottles, ranked like the app. Paged with nextCursor/hasMore/total.

tools.name: add_bottle
tools.description: Add a bottle to your shelf, wishlist or Tried list (same as the app's Add Bottle form). Free accounts can hold 25 unopened/opened bottles; Pro is unlimited. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only aft

tools.name: update_bottle
tools.description: Edit your bottle: notes, price, store, custom name/distillery/proof, batch, barrel details, favorite. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: set_bottle_status
tools.description: Move a bottle between unopened, opened, finished, wishlist and tried. Moving into unopened/opened re-checks the free 25-bottle limit. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: rate_bottle
tools.description: Rate one of your bottles 0-5 in steps of 0.25 (0 clears). Posts a 'rated' update like the app. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: remove_bottle
tools.description: Permanently delete one of your bottles. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: wishlist_add
tools.description: Put a bottle on your wishlist: a new one (expression_path or name), or move an existing bottle_id there. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: wishlist_remove
tools.description: Delete a bottle from your wishlist. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: log_pour
tools.description: Log that you're drinking one of your bottles (posts to your followers' feed, like the app's Pour). Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create one of your collections. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: rename_collection
tools.description: Rename one of your collections (and optionally change its description). Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: delete_collection
tools.description: Delete one of your collections. Its bottles stay on your shelf. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: add_to_collection
tools.description: Add one of your bottles to one of your collections. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: remove_from_collection
tools.description: Take one of your bottles out of one of your collections (the bottle stays on your shelf). Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: delete_my_activity
tools.description: Delete one of your own feed posts (id from list_my_activity). The bottle stays on your shelf. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: follow_user
tools.description: Follow someone (username or userId from search_users). Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: unfollow_user
tools.description: Stop following someone. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: block_user
tools.description: Block someone: hides their posts and profile from your feed, Explore and Discover (doesn't unfollow, like the app). Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: unblock_all_users
tools.description: Unblock every user you've blocked (same as Profile → Unblock All Users). Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Edit your profile like Edit Profile in the app: displayName, bio, location, website, instagram, twitter, facebook, tiktok. Only fields you pass change; an empty string clears an optional field. Photos and handle aren't changed here (see set_username). Two steps: the first call only previews and retu

tools.name: set_username
tools.description: Change your @handle (3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, underscore). Your old handle is released. Use check_username first. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report, feature idea or other feedback to the Instadram team as you (same as Profile → Send Feedback). 10–5000 characters. Two steps: the first call only previews and returns confirm_token; show the preview to the user and repeat the call with confirm_token only after they agree.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "whoami" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_users, get_user, list_user_activity, fetch_bottle_reviews, get_feed, check_username · Private data: whoami, list_my_bottles, get_shelf_value, export_shelf · Public sink: search_users, get_user, send_feedback · Destructive: remove_bottle, wishlist_remove, delete_collection, remove_from_collection, delete_my_activity.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_users, get_user, list_user_activity, fetch_bottle_reviews, get_feed, check_username · Private data: whoami, list_my_bottles, get_shelf_value, export_shelf · Public sink: search_users, get_user, send_feedback · Destructive: remove_bottle, wishlist_remove, delete_collection, remove_from_collection, delete_my_activity

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
